name: Jcode: Coding Agent
subtitle: The official Jcode mobile app
promotionalText: Chat with your Jcode coding agent running on your own cloud machine. Start tasks, follow tool calls live and review answers from anywhere.
description:
Jcode is an open-source AI coding agent. Jcode for iPhone connects to your Jcode Cloud machine so you can keep working with your agent away from your desk.

- Sign in with Google or a one-time email code.
- Chat with the agent in multiple session tabs.
- Watch tool calls, file edits and command output stream in as the agent works.
- Read rich Markdown answers with code blocks.
- Your cloud machine wakes on demand and sleeps when idle.

Sign in with an existing Jcode account. You can permanently delete your account from Settings inside the app.

review.notes: Sign in: type the demo email into the email field, tap 'Email me a code', then enter the six-digit code from the password field. No inbox access is needed for this account. After sign-in the app wakes the account's cloud machine (up to about a minute) and opens a chat. Send any message, for example 'Write a hello world in Rust', to see the coding agent respond. Account deletion: tap the menu button (top left) to open Settings, then 'Delete account'. The app has no in-app purchases and no purchase links. Sign in with Apple is also offered on the sign-in screen and creates a new, empty account. Optional extras: a Share extension (share text into Jcode), a Live Activity showing agent progress, and push notifications when an agent finishes. All require only the signed-in account.
